messages.subject: Advanced SECR workshop
parts:
I am offering a 2-day advanced course on spatially explicit capture-recapture (SECR) modelling in Dunedin, New Zealand, before the Queenstown SEEM conference in June 2015. Participants should have experience of capture–recapture methods and be confident users of R. Content will be customised to the interests of participants. Please see here for details.
Murray
